headline: EA is shutting down BioWare and cutting around 400 jobs
standfirst: Skate studio Full Circle will be be reduced to "a more focused, smaller team," while a Sims project has been paused.
body_markdown:
Skate studio Full Circle will be be reduced to "a more focused, smaller team," while a Sims project has been paused. (Engadget)

**Deadline** adds: After going private in August, Electronic Arts (EA) is cutting about 3% of its staff and shutting down video game developer BioWare.

**Hindustan Times** adds: In a memo to staff, Chief Studios Officer Cam Weber and COO David Tinson said the company reviewed its business over recent months.

**Anadolu Agency** adds: US video game publisher plans to cut 3% of workforce as part of restructuring following $55B Saudi-led buyout

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by Deadline, Engadget, Hindustan Times and Anadolu Agency. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
